stemMarkdown: A boat covers 55 km downstream in 2.5000 hours and the same 55 km upstream in 9.1667 hours. Find the speed of the stream (in km/h). (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream speed $= \dfrac{55}{2.5000} = 22.0000$ km/h and upstream speed $= \dfrac{55}{9.1667} = 6.0000$ km/h. The stream speed is half their difference: $8$ km/h.
